title: Optimization baseline: bottleneck hunting with a misleading serializer
fixture_requirements: A staged image pipeline (decode -> transform -> encode) where the real bottleneck is transform.resize: it scans the full input image for every output pixel (O(outWidth*outHeight*inWidth*inHeight), ~97% of wall time at 32x32 -> 128x128).
A misleading serializer in encode: a per-pixel string append loop that looks quadratic (O(n^2) concatenation) but is linear under V8 ropes (~2-3% of wall time).
A timing harness (src/bench.js) with configurable warmup and repetition that reports per-stage medians, so the agent can capture a baseline and re-measure on the same input.
A deterministic sample input (samples/image-32.txt) and a golden output whose checksum the oracle verifies byte-for-byte; a correct fix must change speed, not bytes.
No test suite, linter, or CI configuration; the agent must measure rather than rely on repository tooling.
A maintenance proposal documented in the prompt: switch encode's append loop to array+join() — the wrong target, since encode is not the hotspot; the agent must evaluate it with evidence.
